name: beyond_iid_mathematics

node_types.name: MathematicalObject
node_types.description: A mathematical object with its precise domain and conventions.

node_types.name: Definition
node_types.description: An exact definition, including notation and normalization.

node_types.name: Statement
node_types.description: A source-attributed mathematical statement, with exact qualifiers; extraction does not prove it.

node_types.name: Assumption
node_types.description: An explicit condition required for a statement or argument; unresolved applicability remains open.

node_types.name: ProofArgument
node_types.description: One particular source proof or derivation, distinct from its conclusion.

node_types.name: ProofStep
node_types.description: A particular justified step of a particular proof.

node_types.name: ProofObligation
node_types.description: A mathematical prerequisite whose discharge is separately evidenced.

node_types.name: ProjectRequirement
node_types.description: A desired project property, never a literature fact or proved result.

node_types.name: Hypothesis
node_types.description: An unproved candidate with exact scope and parameters.

node_types.name: Counterexample
node_types.description: An evidenced construction that violates a precise statement under stated conditions.

relation_types.name: defines
relation_types.description: Definition of an object with matching conventions; no prerequisite closure.

relation_types.name: has_assumption
relation_types.description: Explicit source condition. Direction: conditioned item to its prerequisite.

relation_types.name: requires
relation_types.description: Explicit prerequisite of this particular argument, step or obligation. Never theorem-level mathematical necessity inferred from one proof.

relation_types.name: has_step
relation_types.description: A required step in this particular source proof. Direction argument to required step.

relation_types.name: proves
relation_types.description: Source presents this argument for this conclusion. Attribution to a proof is not independent proof verification.

relation_types.name: discharges
relation_types.description: Proposed discharge with separately inspectable exact evidence; does not automatically close the obligation.

relation_types.name: uses_definition
relation_types.description: Uses this precise definition; navigational, no necessity inferred.

relation_types.name: refutes
relation_types.description: Exact violated statement and applicability must be recorded; source-supported assertion, not automatic verification.

relation_types.name: addresses
relation_types.description: Relevance to a desired property; never establishes fulfillment.

instructions: Property contract beyond_iid_mathematics@1.0.0: every node except Source has properties.mathematics with nonempty strings exact_statement, quantifiers, domain, parameters, normalization, smoothing, distance, dimension_dependence, attribution, assumptions; and unresolved, an array of strings. Use explicit 'not_applicable' only when justified, or 'unknown' plus an unresolved entry for unavailable/damaged information. Preserve equations, source notation, domains, all quantifiers and parameter ranges exactly. Definitions with different smoothing, distance, normalization, dimensions or domains are distinct. ProjectRequirement mathematics.epistemic_kind must equal desired; Hypothesis must equal hypothesis; Counterexample must equal counterexample; Statement must equal source_statement. Source nodes require properties.attribution. Every necessary_dependency edge requires properties.dependency_scope (proof_specific or explicit_condition), properties.rationale and exact evidence. has_assumption uses explicit_condition; requires and has_step use proof_specific. A lemma used by one proof is a prerequisite of that ProofArgument/ProofStep, never necessary for every proof of its conclusion. Citations, supports, prose similarity, co-occurrence and proves edges do not entail truth. Keep unresolved assumptions open; do not invent missing formulas or dependencies. Properties carry extraction proposals; independent mathematical verification remains separate.
